Prices

Questions

How much do projects in industry solutions cost?
An MVP in this group costs $4,000–70,000 (UZS 48–845 mln), a full version up to $220,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 3–20 weeks, a full version 8–48 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today and sample documents; Existing data: Excel or an old system; Staff to try the system; One person who makes the decisions.
